summary: BiomX Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the cancellation of 1,013,637 restricted shares issued upon partial conversion of a convertible promissory note under a revolving line of credit related to a prior acquisition of a 60% interest in Dr. Frucht Systems Ltd. The NYSE American advised that the transactions required stockholder approval under Section 712 of its Company Guide. The shares were canceled and returned to treasury; the company intends to seek stockholder approval. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing addressing a share issuance and cancellation, not a standalone special situation.
